findings.title: Cleanup interval is reduced from ten minutes to one
findings.body: This changes the global cleanup scheduler from running every ten minutes to every minute, although the PR is addressing annotation cleanup. That makes every cleanup job—including snapshot, dashboard-version, image, invite, URL, and query-history cleanup—run up to ten times as often, increasing database and service load and potentially making cleanup work contend with normal traffic.

findings.title: Successful cleanup batches are logged as errors
findings.body: This `Error` log runs for every batch even when fetching IDs succeeded, and the analogous success-path logs below also use `Error`. Normal cleanup therefore produces error-level entries repeatedly, including the selected IDs, which misrepresents successful operation and can pollute alerts and error dashboards. Log successful batches at an appropriate lower level, reserving error logs for failures.
